Apple Human Interface Guidelines design skill covering design principles, components, typography, colors, SF Symbols, accessibility, and platform-specific guidance.

- Initial release providing comprehensive Apple HIG reference, best practices, and avoidable pitfalls for all Apple platforms, including visionOS.
- Includes detailed guides on typography, color system, icon usage, component specifications, accessibility, and animation.
- Offers quick reference tables for font sizes, system colors, touch targets, and layout standards.
- Highlights common mistakes, version traps, and platform-specific design nuances.
- Contains design principles and detailed explanations adapted from Apple HIG 2026.
- Quick access to SF Symbols and ready-to-use design patterns per Apple platforms.
